learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn why every single job is important and how treating all types of work with respect makes our world a beautiful place!

main_concepts.concept_title: 👑 Dignity of Labour: No Job is Small
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Whether someone is a doctor saving lives or a cleaner sweeping the streets, both are doing important work! Respecting every type of job equally is called the Dignity of Labour.
Not all hard work is paid with money. When your parents cook dinner, clean the house, or help with your homework, they are doing unpaid work out of love. This work is incredibly valuable!

main_concepts.concept_title: ⚖️ Breaking the Rules: Anyone Can Do Anything
main_concepts.simple_explanation: In the past, people thought some jobs were only for men and some only for women. Today, women are flying airplanes and men are top chefs! Work has no gender.

fun_activity.title: 🙏 The Gratitude Interview
fun_activity.instructions: Talk to an adult who does a job you do not know much about (like a security guard, a vegetable vendor, or a plumber). Ask them what they love most about their work and thank them for what they do!

quick_recap: ⭐ All types of honest work deserve equal respect and dignity.
⭐ Unpaid work, like the chores done at home by family members, is extremely important.
⭐ Boys and girls can choose to pursue any profession they want based on their talents.
